details: Bitcoin recovered from a brief dip to climb above $77,300, driven by easing tensions and progress on a potential US-Iran peace agreement. Despite ETF outflows, on-chain data shows large investors accumulating BTC, and futures open interest has risen over 10%.
title: Bitcoin Rebounds on Hopes of US-Iran Deal Progress

details: Elevated oil prices near $100 and disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz fuel inflation fears, impacting bond yields and weighing on cryptocurrency markets. The macroeconomic pressure and ongoing geopolitical risks create a risk-off environment that limits Bitcoin's upside.
title: Oil Prices and Geopolitical Risk Continue to Affect Crypto

details: The ongoing Russia-Ukraine conflict serves as a persistent background risk, contributing to overall global uncertainty. It continues to influence long-term stability and could lead to increased regulatory scrutiny on stablecoins.
title: Ukraine War's Lingering Impact
